lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-intensity circular clusters arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows. Immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, a vertical alignment of four distinct nodes is visible, forming a rectangular sub-pattern with the subsequent posterior column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like arrangement of high-contrast nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the flank. The median ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient transition from illuminated pixels above to shadowed pixels below along its entire visible length.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily toward the posterior margin of the fin's silhouette.
